issues.failure_explanation: For the displayed 3-by-2 off-diagonal block, the block equation is $aZ_{s,t+1}+bZ_{s+1,t}+Z_{s+1,t+1}=0$; it forces $Z_{2,2}=Z_{3,1}=Z_{3,2}=0$ and the additional relation $aZ_{1,2}+bZ_{2,1}=0$. Thus the displayed independent $f_{12},f_{21}$ are wrong, and $Z_{21}$ is not generally $Z_{12}^T$ unless an extra relation between $a$ and $b$ is imposed.

failure_location.quote: and $Z_{21}$ has the same form as $Z_{12}^T$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct or delete the example by imposing the actual block recurrence relations, e.g. for the displayed blocks use $Z_{2,2}=Z_{3,1}=Z_{3,2}=0$ and $aZ_{1,2}+bZ_{2,1}=0$, and treat $Z_{21}$ as an independent block of the same type rather than as $Z_{12}^T$.
issues.overall_effect: The illustrative parameter count and transpose symmetry for solutions of the Sylvester-type equation defining $\Theta_{(a,b,j)}$ are incorrect for unequal Jordan-block sizes. Later results that only use membership in $\Theta_{(a,b,j)}$ are not thereby invalidated.
issues.title: Example exa1 gives a false normal form for off-diagonal blocks of Theta_(a,b,j)
issues.why_classification: No labelled theorem depends on the illustrative transpose claim; the repair is local and the substantive $\Theta$-membership statements used later survive.

issues.failure_explanation: For a nonreal unit-modulus pair, the real block is a rotation block and, with $\epsilon=-1$, the conditions $\Gamma_R^T=\Gamma_R$ and $J_R\Gamma_R=\Gamma_RJ_R^{-T}$ force a real symmetric trace-zero block $\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\b&-a\end{bmatrix}$, not $\hat\xi_jI_2$. Equivalently, the complex block in (gs-g-2) is off-diagonal; a diagonal scalar block satisfies the intertwining equation only in the singular case or for real $\lambda$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the blocks $\hat\xi_jI_2$, $j=r_1+1,\ldots,r_2$, in the $T$-anti-palindromic part of cor-1 by arbitrary real symmetric trace-zero $2\times2$ blocks $\begin{bmatrix}a_j&b_j\\b_j&-a_j\end{bmatrix}$, consistently with (gs-g-2).
issues.overall_effect: For $T$-anti-palindromic spectra with simple nonreal unit-modulus eigenvalues, the displayed $\Gamma_R$ need not lie in $\mathcal{S}_{(J_R,T,-1)}$. Consequently the corollary's parameterization is false in that case, and thm-IEP is unreliable insofar as it cites this cor-1 form for constructing the inverse-eigenvalue solution.
issues.title: Corollary cor-1 uses diagonal scalar blocks for T-anti-palindromic unit-modulus simple eigenvalues
issues.why_classification: The correction is contained and leaves a comparable simple-eigenvalue parameterization, but it changes the advertised block for a whole class of $T$-anti-palindromic spectra and fixes a mis-specification used by thm-IEP.

issues.failure_explanation: The formulas are justified by applying the spectral decomposition to $(\tilde X,\tilde\Lambda)$, which requires $[\tilde X;\tilde X\tilde\Lambda]$ to be nonsingular. The assumptions on $\Phi$ and $\tilde\Gamma_1$ give only $\Phi\tilde\Gamma_1\Phi^\star=\Gamma_1$; they do not imply the needed updated eigenvector matrix is nonsingular, nor that $X_1\Phi\tilde\Lambda_1$ can replace $X_1\Lambda_1\Phi$. The statement also uses $\tilde X_1$ before defining it; the proof silently sets $\tilde X_1=X_1\Phi$.

failure_location.quote: for any nonsingular matrix $\Phi\in\mathbb{K}^{p\times p}$ and $\tilde{\Gamma}_1\in\mathcal{S}_{\tilde{\Lambda}_1}$ satisfying

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define $\tilde X_1=X_1\Phi$ in the statement and add the hypothesis that $[X_1\Phi,X_2;X_1\Phi\tilde\Lambda_1,X_2\Lambda_2]$ is nonsingular, equivalently that $(\tilde X,\tilde\Lambda)$ is a standard pair; the existing substitution then proves the displayed formulas.
issues.overall_effect: The eigenvalue-embedding guarantee is not established for every nonsingular $\Phi$; for updates making the new eigenvector matrix singular, the constructed pair need not be a standard pair and the no-spill-over conclusion can fail.
issues.title: Theorem thm-eep omits the updated standard-pair nonsingularity hypothesis
issues.why_classification: The needed repair is a contained added hypothesis and definition rather than new global proof architecture, but it restricts the advertised 'for any nonsingular $\Phi$' quantifier and is essential to the argument.
